fewShots.question: Was any data lost in the latest run?
fewShots.query: SELECT entity, status, source_rows, bronze_rows, silver_rows, quarantined_rows, merged_rows, lost_rows FROM dbo.meta_trust_summary WHERE checked_at = (SELECT MAX(checked_at) FROM dbo.meta_trust_summary) ORDER BY entity

fewShots.question: Which reconciliation checks failed or are pending?
fewShots.query: SELECT entity, check_name, left_layer, left_value, right_layer, right_value, difference, status, note FROM dbo.meta_reconciliation WHERE checked_at = (SELECT MAX(checked_at) FROM dbo.meta_reconciliation) AND status <> 'PASS' ORDER BY entity, check_name

fewShots.question: When did the pipeline last run and did it succeed?
fewShots.query: SELECT TOP 1 run_id, status, started_at, ended_at, duration_s, failed_steps, skipped_steps, reconcile_fail FROM dbo.meta_pipeline_runs ORDER BY started_at DESC

fewShots.question: Why did the last failed run fail?
fewShots.query: SELECT activity_name, status, error_code, error_message FROM dbo.meta_pipeline_activity_runs WHERE run_id = (SELECT TOP 1 run_id FROM dbo.meta_pipeline_runs WHERE status = 'Failed' ORDER BY started_at DESC) AND status <> 'Succeeded'

fewShots.question: Why were rows quarantined?
fewShots.query: SELECT q.entity, q.reason_code, COUNT(*) AS rows_quarantined FROM dbo.meta_quarantine q JOIN (SELECT entity, run_id FROM (SELECT entity, run_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity ORDER BY logged_at DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.meta_quarantine) x WHERE rn = 1) l ON q.entity = l.entity AND q.run_id = l.run_id GROUP BY q.entity, q.reason_code ORDER BY rows_quarantined DESC

fewShots.question: How many duplicates were merged and why?
fewShots.query: SELECT m.entity, m.reason_code, COUNT(*) AS rows_merged FROM dbo.meta_merge_log m JOIN (SELECT entity, run_id FROM (SELECT entity, run_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY entity ORDER BY logged_at DESC) AS rn FROM dbo.meta_merge_log) x WHERE rn = 1) l ON m.entity = l.entity AND m.run_id = l.run_id GROUP BY m.entity, m.reason_code ORDER BY rows_merged DESC

fewShots.question: Which data is missing?
fewShots.query: SELECT DISTINCT entity, gap_type, expected_key, detail FROM dbo.meta_completeness ORDER BY entity, expected_key

fewShots.question: How accurate is the AI cleansing?
fewShots.query: SELECT system, defect_id, method, cases, correct, precision, recall, f1 FROM dbo.meta_ai_scorecard WHERE run_id = (SELECT TOP 1 run_id FROM dbo.meta_ai_scorecard ORDER BY scored_at DESC) ORDER BY system, defect_id, method
